items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 131:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the borrowing of the vessels of Rachel by Leah? Behold, at midnight, when the Mochin of Aba and Ima reached ZON from the illumination of the upper AB and SAG, which lower the bottom Hey from the eyes to the mouth, then the HGT of ZA become KHB, and the NHY of ZA become HGT, and new NHY, clarified from Beriah, come out to it. It is found that Leah, who used to end at the point of the chest in smallness, now ends at the place of the Yesod, for the NHY of ZA became HGT, and it is found that the point of the chest descended to the place of the crown of the Yesod of before, and with them the feet of Leah descended until the end of ZA. And then it is discerned that "Leah borrowed the vessels of Rachel," for these NHY are the place of Rachel, as above in Answer 127. And now Leah borrowed them, as above. And Rachel descended to Beriah, because her Keter, which is the point of the chest of before, now stands at the end of ZA. And it is discerned by the language of borrowing, because this is only for the moment, at night, in order to draw the aspect of vessels and spirit for the need of Rachel; however, in the morning Leah returns to her place and returns this place to Rachel. And therefore it is like the resemblance of a borrowing. And there is yet another reason in the matter, for this place of Rachel that Leah took did not remain in the aspect of Rachel, namely, in revealed Hassadim, but they came in the aspect of Leah to covered Hassadim, since they became HGT. And it is similar to one who borrows a thing from his fellow and makes in it his own use, and not the same use that his fellow, the lender, made in it. (Item 33. Part 1, Page 505, s.v. "and with this").
